<?php
/**
 * Hromadne akce s objednavkami (formular ze seznamu objednavek).
 *
 * POST ids[] + action:
 *   storno   – stornuje vybrane objednavky
 *   paid     – oznaci jako zaplacene (parovani plateb z banky, 2016)
 *   shipped  – oznaci jako odeslane (hromadne odeslani balíku)
 */

global $db;
legacy_db();
auth_require('obchod');
csrf_check();

$ids = isset($_POST['ids']) ? $_POST['ids'] : array();
$action = isset($_POST['action']) ? (string) $_POST['action'] : '';

if (!is_array($ids) || count($ids) == 0) {
    flash('Nevybrali jste žádné objednávky', 'error');
    redirect(admin_url('orders'));
    return;
}

$idList = ids_to_sql($ids);

if ($action == 'storno') {
    // stornovat lze cokoliv krome dorucenych (2017: i odeslane, kdyz se balik vrati)
    $before = $db->query("SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ")");
    $n = $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ") AND status != 'delivered'");
    foreach ($before as $b) {
        if ($b['status'] != 'delivered') {
            // vraceni polozek do skladu
            release_stock_reservations($b['id']);

            // vypocet a zaznam vracenych financnich prostredku
            $refund = calculate_refund_amount($b['id']);
            audit_log('order', $b['id'], 'storno', array(
                'from' => $b['status'],
                'bulk' => true,
                'refund_amount' => $refund['amount'],
                'refund_currency' => $refund['currency']
            ));
        }
    }
    flash('Stornováno objednávek: ' . $n);
} elseif ($action == 'paid') {
    $n = $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ") AND status = 'confirmed'");
    foreach ($ids as $oid) {
        audit_log('order', $oid, 'status', array('to' => 'paid', 'bulk' => true));
    }
    flash('Označeno jako zaplacené: ' . $n);
} elseif ($action == 'shipped') {
    $n = $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status = 'shipped' WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ") AND status = 'paid'");
    foreach ($ids as $oid) {
        audit_log('order', $oid, 'status', array('to' => 'shipped', 'bulk' => true));
    }
    flash('Označeno jako odeslané: ' . $n);
} else {
    flash('Neznámá akce', 'error');
}

cache_delete('dashboard_stats');
redirect(admin_url('orders'));

/**
 * Vrati polozky zrusene objednavky zpet do skladu (odstrani rezervace).
 */
function release_stock_reservations($orderId)
{
    global $db;
    $stock_items = $db->query("SELECT product_id, reservations FROM stock_items");

    foreach ($stock_items as $item) {
        $reservations = json_decode($item['reservations'] ?? '{}', true) ?: array();

        if (isset($reservations[$orderId])) {
            unset($reservations[$orderId]);
            $newReservations = empty($reservations) ? '{}' : json_encode($reservations);
            $sql = "UPDATE stock_items SET reservations = " . $db->quote($newReservations) . " WHERE product_id = " . $db->quote($item['product_id']);
            $db->exec($sql);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Vypocita celkovy zpusobilej vracenych financnich prostredku na zaklade objednanych polozek.
 */
function calculate_refund_amount($orderId)
{
    global $db;

    $sql = "SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_amount_in_cents) as total_cents, unit_price_currency FROM order_items "
        . "WHERE order_id = " . $db->quote($orderId) . " "
        . "GROUP BY unit_price_currency";
    $result = $db->one($sql);

    if ($result) {
        return array(
            'amount' => (int) $result['total_cents'],
            'currency' => (string) $result['unit_price_currency']
        );
    }

    // fallback na oryginalnu valutu objednavky
    $order = $db->one("SELECT currency FROM orders WHERE id = " . $db->quote($orderId));
    return array(
        'amount' => 0,
        'currency' => $order ? $order['currency'] : 'CZK'
    );
}

function customer_name($customerId)
{
    static $cache = array();
    if (isset($cache[$customerId])) {
        return $cache[$customerId];
    }
    global $db;
    legacy_db();
    $c = $db->one("SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE id = '" . $customerId . "'");
    if ($c === null) {
        // zakaznik z noveho e-shopu, ktery jeste neni v customers
        $cache[$customerId] = '(neznámý zákazník)';
    } else {
        $cache[$customerId] = $c['name'] != '' ? $c['name'] : $c['email'];
    }

    return $cache[$customerId];
}

function product_name($productId)
{
    static $cache = array();
    if (isset($cache[$productId])) {
        return $cache[$productId];
    }
    global $db;
    legacy_db();
    $p = $db->one("SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = '" . $productId . "'");
    $cache[$productId] = $p ? $p['name'] : '(smazaný produkt)';

    return $cache[$productId];
}

/**
 * Zapis do auditniho logu.
 */
function audit_log($entity, $entityId, $action, $payload = array())
{
    global $db;
    legacy_db();
    $user = isset($_SESSION['admin_login']) ? $_SESSION['admin_login'] : 'system';
    $payload['user'] = $user;
    $db->exec("INSERT INTO audit_log (entity, entity_id, action, payload, created_at) VALUES ("
        . $db->quote($entity) . ", "
        . $db->quote($entityId) . ", "
        . $db->quote($action) . ", "
        . $db->quote(json_encode($payload)) . ", "
        . "'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')");
}

function array_get($arr, $key, $default = null)
{
    return is_array($arr) && array_key_exists($key, $arr) ? $arr[$key] : $default;
}

/**

{
    return $cents / 100;
}

{
    // carka -> tecka, mezery pryc ("1 200,50" -> 1200.50)
    $kc = str_replace(array(' ', ','), array('', '.'), (string) $kc);

    return (int) round(((float) $kc) * 100);
}

{
    $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders";
    if ($state !== null) {
        $sql .= " WHERE status = '" . $state . "'";
    }
    $r = db_one($sql);

    return $r ? (int) $r['c'] : 0;

function generate_password($len = 8)
{
    $chars = 'abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789';
    $pw = '';
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $pw .= $chars[random_int(0, strlen($chars) - 1)];

/**
 * Seznam ID z checkboxu -> kus SQL "'a','b','c'"
 * (escapuje jen apostrofy, viz db_escape_old)
 */
function ids_to_sql($ids)
{
    $out = array();
    foreach ((array) $ids as $id) {
        $out[] = "'" . db_escape_old($id) . "'";
    }

    return implode(',', $out);
}

 * Most pripravi $GLOBALS['LEGACY_COMMAND'] (viz Http/LegacyFrontController).

function legacy_command($command)
{
    if (!isset($GLOBALS['LEGACY_COMMAND']) || !is_callable($GLOBALS['LEGACY_COMMAND'])) {
        throw new \RuntimeException('Příkazy nového e-shopu jdou volat jen přes /admin/legacy');
    }

    return call_user_func($GLOBALS['LEGACY_COMMAND'], $command);
}

            // vraceni polozek do skladu
            release_stock_reservations($b['id']);

            // vypocet a zaznam vracenych financnich prostredku
            $refund = calculate_refund_amount($b['id']);
            audit_log('order', $b['id'], 'storno', array(
                'from' => $b['status'],
                'bulk' => true,
                'refund_amount' => $refund['amount'],
                'refund_currency' => $refund['currency']
            ));
        }
    }
    flash('Stornováno objednávek: ' . $n);
} elseif ($action == 'paid') {
    $n = $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ") AND status = 'confirmed'");
    foreach ($ids as $oid) {
        audit_log('order', $oid, 'status', array('to' => 'paid', 'bulk' => true));
    }
    flash('Označeno jako zaplacené: ' . $n);
} elseif ($action == 'shipped') {
    $n = $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status = 'shipped' WHERE id IN (" . $idList . ") AND status = 'paid'");
    foreach ($ids as $oid) {
        audit_log('order', $oid, 'status', array('to' => 'shipped', 'bulk' => true));
    }
    flash('Označeno jako odeslané: ' . $n);
} else {
    flash('Neznámá akce', 'error');
}

cache_delete('dashboard_stats');
redirect(admin_url('orders'));

/**
 * Vrati polozky zrusene objednavky zpet do skladu (odstrani rezervace).
 */
function release_stock_reservations($orderId)
{
    global $db;
    $stock_items = $db->query("SELECT product_id, reservations FROM stock_items");

    foreach ($stock_items as $item) {
        $reservations = json_decode($item['reservations'] ?? '{}', true) ?: array();

        if (isset($reservations[$orderId])) {
            unset($reservations[$orderId]);
            $newReservations = empty($reservations) ? '{}' : json_encode($reservations);
            $sql = "UPDATE stock_items SET reservations = " . $db->quote($newReservations) . " WHERE product_id = " . $db->quote($item['product_id']);
            $db->exec($sql);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Vypocita celkovy zpusobilej vracenych financnich prostredku na zaklade objednanych polozek.
 */
function calculate_refund_amount($orderId)
{
    global $db;

    $sql = "SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_amount_in_cents) as total_cents, unit_price_currency FROM order_items "
        . "WHERE order_id = " . $db->quote($orderId) . " "
        . "GROUP BY unit_price_currency";
    $result = $db->one($sql);

    if ($result) {
        return array(
            'amount' => (int) $result['total_cents'],
            'currency' => (string) $result['unit_price_currency']
        );
    }

    // fallback na oryginalnu valutu objednavky
    $order = $db->one("SELECT currency FROM orders WHERE id = " . $db->quote($orderId));
    return array(
        'amount' => 0,
        'currency' => $order ? $order['currency'] : 'CZK'
    );
}
